The camp was highly successful, with several athletes, including Eko Yuli Irawan, a frequent Summer Olympics medal recipient, and Luluk Diana Tri Wijayana, who won gold medals in the following national competitions (XXI National Sports Week (PON) in 2024, which is routinely held every 4 (four) years), after participating in Coach Gaby's training camp.

sub_arguments.title: International Partnerships and Federation Support
sub_arguments.purpose: To demonstrate Qu's collaboration with international weightlifting federations and her role in securing resources for the sport

snippets.text: As an Executive Board Member of the International Weightlifting Federation, Vice President of the Commonwealth Weightlifting Federation and President of the Singapore Weightlifting Federation, I have had the privilege of working closely with Ms. Qu on several initiatives. I have witnessed firsthand her exceptional contributions to the sport of weightlifting and her profound impact on athletes worldwide.

Through Venus Weightlifting and her extensive social media following, Ms. Qu has supported multiple international and local weightlifting events organized by the Singapore Weightlifting Federation, thereby bolstering the visibility and success of these competitions.

Ms. Qu has facilitated connections with international brands and helped secure sponsorships for weightlifting equipment and apparel from companies such as Cluster, Anta, and Luxiaojun. This has significantly enhanced our athletes' training facilities, improving both their performance and the overall quality of their preparation.

Ms. Qu's influence extends beyond elite athletes. She has played a critical role in identifying and nurturing promising young weightlifters. By leveraging her network and resources, Ms. Qu has helped us recruit and provide opportunities for these athletes to hone their skills and realize their potential.

sub_arguments.purpose: To quantify the success of Qu's training methods in producing competitive athletes and medals

snippets.text: In terms of athlete cultivation, Ms. Qu has helped more than 20 students win medals in competitions around the world with her training system; therein, 12 athletes have made their step in the professional arena, become a vital new force in the global weightlifting industry, and won multiple championships. Ms. Qu has cultivated not only athletes with excellent skills but also an abundant young force with great potential for the future of China's weightlifting industry.

As the Founder of OneFit and a leader in fitness training, I'm pleased to recommend Yaru Qu (Gaby) to you. During our several times of cooperation (such as weightlifting coach training and athlete injury prevention), I was deeply impressed by Yaru Qu's excellence in weightlifting training for the Olympic Games in particular.

I founded OneFit in 2011 with the purpose of introducing world- class fitness techniques into China, pioneering the coach training system in China. With 13- year efforts, OneFit has developed into a leading fitness brand in China. It has 14 branch stores, has cumulatively trained over 200,000 coaches, and has its training courses adopted by many international fitness institutions.
